plan.subject: Understand the fundamental principles and mechanics of linear regression, including its components, cost function, and optimization techniques.
plan.objective: Understand the fundamental principles and mechanics of linear regression, including its components, cost function, and optimization techniques.

blocks.title: Linear Regression Basics
blocks.teachingObjective: Linear regression is the foundation of predictive modeling for continuous outcomes.

blocks.title: Cost Function and Mean Squared Error
blocks.teachingObjective: The cost function quantifies model performance and is essential for optimization.
examples: MSE is a differentiable and convex function

blocks.title: Gradient Descent
blocks.teachingObjective: Gradient descent is the primary optimization algorithm used to minimize the cost function.
examples: Gradient descent is an iterative optimization technique

blocks.title: Model Parameters and Interpretation
blocks.teachingObjective: Understanding parameters like the intercept and regression coefficient is key to interpreting the model.
examples: Residual plots expose a biased model
